project.name: Acme Notes
project.title: UX review
project.description: A small, synthetic example: a phone and desktop pass over a notes app. Two fixes have shipped; the rest is tracked below.

screenshots.caption: Editor on a phone, scrolled to the bottom.

issues.title: Save is hidden behind the bottom navigation
issues.details:
On phones the **Save** button sits under the bottom nav, so edits are lost when people leave the page.

- Reproduce: open any note, scroll to the end
- Expected: Save is always visible
issues.note: Fixed in #1: the form footer is sticky above the nav.

issues.title: Primary button is low contrast
issues.details: The pale primary button fails WCAG AA (2.1:1).
issues.note: The editor uses the solid primary now; the share sheet still uses the pale variant.

issues.title: List rows truncate titles after 12 characters
Root cause: one layout component is reused for phone and desktop
issues.details: Several phone issues trace back to the shared `PageLayout` that hides content with CSS instead of rendering one tree.

issues.title: Date and title columns overlap in the notes table
issues.details: Long dates run into the title column at 1440 px.
issues.note: Fixed in #2: explicit column widths and a row actions column.

issues.title: Export button does nothing
issues.note: Checked: the export runs in the background and emails the file, as designed.

issues.title: Settings page has no keyboard shortcut
issues.note: Out of scope for this release.

issues.title: Bulk delete has no confirmation
issues.details: Selecting rows and pressing *Delete* removes them immediately, with no undo.

fixes.title: Sticky Save bar on phone forms
fixes.summary: The form footer is now `position: sticky` above the bottom navigation, and uses the solid primary button.

mobile.description: Pixel 7 portrait, editor scrolled to the bottom.

before.caption: Save is pale and **under** the bottom nav.

after.caption: Cancel and Save sit in a sticky bar above the nav.

fixes.title: Notes table columns no longer overlap
fixes.summary: Columns get explicit widths and the dates wrap onto two lines. A row actions column was added.

before.caption: Dates (red) run into the title column.

after.caption: Fixed widths, row actions on the right.

mobile.description: Phones use the card list, which was not affected.

plan.title: Roadmap
plan.intro: Effort: S = under half a day, M = 1–2 days.

items.title: Confirm or undo for bulk delete
One solid primary button style everywhere
Render one layout tree per breakpoint

appendix.title: Method
appendix.body:
Every page was opened at **412x915** (portrait phone) and **1440x900**. Screenshots were taken with Playwright before and after each fix.
